rationale: The assistant correctly identified the jockey pulley / drum rollers / felts as candidate causes, told the customer to unplug before hands-on checks, led with free levelling (including sensible wooden-floor advice), and adapted well when the customer said they couldn't tilt the machine, pivoting to standing-up localisation checks and a repairer with a clear brief. Hedging was reasonable throughout, though it never raised the condensate pump as a possibility and listed part kits to search for before any panel inspection (framed conditionally, so not an unjustified purchase push). Minor repetition of recall and stop-use advice, but nothing blocking; a UK homeowner would be well served.
